thread:
Maria (CS): FYI Acme renewal — customer emailed: they want to move 25 seats from Pro -> Team, split invoices across two billing entities (ACME-NA / ACME-EMEA), and staged signers (EMEA legal signs first). They also asked for a one-off onboarding credit of $5k applied to the NA invoice. Need to close by Tue 3/21. Can we confirm procurement path and whether legal amendment is required?

Jon (AE): Thanks Maria. Looping in @Kevin (Legal) and @Sam (Finance). Is the $5k credit okay from sales side?

Kevin (Legal): Quick Q — is this a pricing tier change or just invoice routing? If it's a true tier change we should do a short amendment (1 para). I can draft a waiver if both entities sign. Also need the quote/SOW id.

Ana (RevOps): On invoice split: we can produce two invoices but we need vendor_code for EMEA and PO numbers for each entity. Sam, can finance accept two POs under the same commitment?

Sam (Finance): We can accept two POs. Please have procurement send `PO-EMEA-<custid>` and `PO-NA-<custid>` formats. For the $5k credit we need internal approval -- pinged billing approvers, ETA EOD.

Maria (CS): Pasting customer email snippet:

> We're moving 25 seats to Team, 75+ remain Pro. Please bill EMEA entity (EU-ACME) for 40 seats, NA-ACME for 60 seats. EMEA legal needs to sign first. Please apply onboarding credit to NA invoice. PO numbers will be provided by procurement by Mon.

Jon (AE): If legal needs to sign first we should use sequential signing in DocuSign. Kevin, can you confirm legal ok with staged envelope? @DocuSign Bot any constraints?

Kevin (Legal): Sequential signing is fine. I'll prep the amendment referencing quote id `Q-2784` and add the credit line. Small ask: include an acceptance clause to avoid ambiguity on which entity is liable for which seats.

DocuSign Bot: Envelope created (env_94321). Routing set to: EMEA Legal -> NA Finance -> Company Exec. Will notify when EMEA signs.

Sam (Finance): Approved provisional credit pending signed amendment and POs. I'll update vendor codes once POs arrive. :thumbsup:

Maria (CS): Great — action items:
- Kevin: draft amendment (reference `Q-2784`, add $5k credit, acceptance clause)
- Jon: confirm quote id and customer PO timeline
- Sam: standby for POs and finalize vendor codes
- Ana: prepare billing split in system once POs arrive
Target: sign by Tue. Thanks everyone.
